gate.training_gate: Pending independent adapter tests, professor-container runtime audit, PyWavelets environment/cache verification, and one fixed-batch-128 forward/backward correctness/resource smoke.
gate.design_resolution: Questions 1-12 approved by the project owner on 2026-10-04; PyWavelets and chunked float32 CWT caching selected; physical batch 128 is authoritative for both walks.
reasons: No software licence was found in the official repository.
Fourier and wavelet encoders do not directly support sequence length 64.
Paper and source disagree on inference-mapper hidden width.
Paper and source disagree on joint mapping-loss scaling.
The source uses two full epoch loops while the project contract requires an explicit fixed-budget interpretation.
The source selects a minimum training-loss encoder checkpoint rather than the project's fixed final checkpoint.
Paper batch size 1024 was run on 24GB while the project device has 8GB.
gate.failure_policy: Record LWA feasibility or training failure; do not substitute another method implicitly.
